messages:
anya: Heads-up: we need to firm up model deprecation communication flow. Sequence: notice -> preview opt-in -> final sunset. Can we scope who owns each message?

ben: Product should own the notice and final sunset emails. CS should run the preview opt-in comms. Engineering provides the telemetry hooks (flags + usage reports).

ritika: For large customers we should include migration guides and code snippets for pinning. Also propose templated support tickets with rollback request options.

evan: Infra note: add a deprecation flag on model artifacts and an API to query "will this model be deprecatable?" so sales can answer customer queries. Also need an automated grace window for pinned customers.

anya: Risk threshold: if more than 0.5% of active tenants have custom pins to a model, escalate to cross-functional review before sunset.

ben: Add a final hold point: a last-chance compatibility shim that runs popular routes on the legacy stack for 7 days. If no major regressions, proceed.

ritika: Also capture migration incentives: extended grace for pinned customers, professional services credits, or migration support.

infra-bot: scheduled: deprecation-notice-workflow v0.1 -> staging 2026-05-12T09:00:00Z

anya: Action items: Ben draft notice templates, Ritika draft migration snippets, Evan add artifact flag and list API. Due EOW. Anything else?

ben: Suggest tracking "pin depth" (how many routes per tenant pinned) so we can prioritize who to contact first.

ritika: Good call. We'll surface pin depth in CS dashboard.

anya: Great. Let's reconvene after prototypes.
